party.vote.opened: {name} asks to switch to {channel}. Vote within {seconds} s: the request counts as a vote for, blanks do not count.
party.vote.openedByAgent: {name} proposes switching to {channel}. Vote within {seconds} s: blanks do not count.
party.vote.forced: {name} forces the switch to {channel}, without a vote.
party.vote.solo: Switching to {channel} (asked by {name}), a few seconds of interruption.
party.vote.refused: No majority for {channel} ({yes} for, {no} against): staying as we are.
party.vote.alone: Nobody else is watching: switching to {channel}.
party.vote.passed: Majority for {channel} ({yes} for, {no} against): switching, a few seconds of interruption.
party.vote.switchFailed: Majority for {channel}, but the switch failed ({error}): staying as we are.
party.vote.providerOpened.switchToBackup: Proposal: switch to the backup provider. Vote within {seconds} s.
party.vote.providerOpened.returnToPrimar: Proposal: return to the main provider. Vote within {seconds} s.
party.vote.providerFailed: Provider change approved but it could not be applied.
party.vote.providerDeclined: Provider change declined: staying as we are.
party.poll.started: New poll: "{question}". Vote in the panel or type your answer ({seconds} s).
party.poll.startedScore: New poll: "{question}". Give your score in the panel or type it, for example 2-1 ({seconds} s).
party.poll.startedOpen: New poll: "{question}". Answer in the panel or type your answer ({seconds} s).
party.alert.unstable: {channel} has seemed unstable for {minutes} min. Everyone receives the same stream: it is not your device. Tell me if it persists or if you want to change channel.
party.sync.fineSolo: {name} is aligned with the watch party (within {ms} ms)
party.sync.fineSoloMissed: {name} could not get a fine alignment (still {seconds} s off): the regular resync takes over
party.sync.removedDisruptions: {name} was removed from the watch party: {count} sync disruptions in 30 min. They can rejoin at any time.
party.sync.removedRequested: {name} was removed from the watch party at the family's request. They can rejoin at any time.
party.sync.golive: The whole watch party is going back to live
party.title: Party room
party.subtitle: Chat, votes, polls and ideas around what everyone is watching.
party.chat.rateLimited: Slow down: too many messages in a few seconds.
party.vote.yours: You asked: your request counts as a vote for.
party.vote.result.refused: No majority: staying on this channel.
party.vote.result.impossible: The vote passed but the switch was not possible.
party.vote.result.cancelled: Vote cancelled: nobody left to decide.
party.switch.title: Change channel
party.switch.outcome.presenceUnavailable: Cannot tell who is watching right now. Try again in a moment.
party.switch.outcome.offAir: This channel does not answer right now.
party.poll.title: Poll
party.poll.question: Question
party.presence.title: Watching ({count})
party.ideas.title: Ideas box
party.ideas.placeholder: A suggestion, a bug, a remark
